Kauhalaśikṣā
or kauhalIyazikSA on vaidic phonetics. ascribed to Kauhala. Adyar I. p. 52b. Adyar D. I. 777. 778. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 20. MD. 893. Oppert I. 970. II. 744. 2596. 5736. 7364. 7947. 9458.
Q. in a. a.. C. on Siddhāntaśikṣā of Śrīnivāsa. See Ind. Ant. V. p.. 193-200; also IO. 4964 (Kāhala).
--C. Vyākhyā. Trav. Uni. L. 1346C (inc.).

Kauhalīputra
grammarian. Q. in Taittirīyaprātiśākhya, 17, 2 an. in the C. on Taitt. Prātiº, V. 39-41.
See JAOS. VII. p. 405.

Kauhaleya
Q. in Tribhāṣyaratnākara C. on Taittirīyaprātiśākhya; ref. to in Bhāradvājaśikṣā (see PUL. II. App. p. 12).
C.. Kauhalaśikṣā an. Kauhalīputra.
